title: Detailed telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='84' cy='45' rx='2' ry='6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <path d='M92 20 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z' fill='#ffe97a'/>
